headers.work_nil:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ) :
    work Q w h [] E = 1
headers.work_cons:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ)
    (R : TypedInput n) (rs : List (TypedInput n)) :
    work Q w h (R::rs) E = (R.hosts.map fun H => StoredHosts.hostBound Q E H+2).sum+3+
      work Q w h rs (updated Q E w h R)
headers.candidate_trace:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ) (R : TypedInput n) (rs : List Input) :
    ∃ k,k≤(R.hosts.map fun H => StoredHosts.hostBound Q E H+2).sum+3 ∧
      Trace (transition (StoredEdges.encode Q) (StoredRecords.encodeWeights w) n h) k
        (.candidates (encode R::rs) (StoredEdges.encode E))
        (.candidates rs (StoredEdges.encode (updated Q E w h R)))
headers.candidates_trace:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ) (rs : List (TypedInput n)) :
    ∃ k,k≤work Q w h rs E ∧
      Trace (transition (StoredEdges.encode Q) (StoredRecords.encodeWeights w) n h) k
        (.candidates (rs.map encode) (StoredEdges.encode E))
        (.halt (StoredEdges.encode (selected Q w h rs E)))

headers.updated_eq_original:
(Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ e,0≤w e) (t : ℚ) (eligible : Sym2 (Fin n) → Finset J)
    (host : J → Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) (tape : SampledGreedy.Tape (Fin n) J)
    (h : ℕ) (R : TypedInput n) (hb : R.budget=t*w s(R.edge.1,R.edge.2))
    (hr : HostRepresentation E eligible host tape R) :
    StoredSample.edgeSet (updated Q E w h R)=
      originalStep (StoredSample.edgeSet Q) w hw t eligible host tape h
        (StoredSample.edgeSet E) s(R.edge.1,R.edge.2)
headers.selected_eq_fold:
(Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n)) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ e,0≤w e) (t : ℚ) (eligible : Sym2 (Fin n) → Finset J)
    (host : J → Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) (tape : SampledGreedy.Tape (Fin n) J)
    (h : ℕ) (rs : List (TypedInput n))
    (hr : ValidSchedule Q w t eligible host tape h rs E) :
    StoredSample.edgeSet (selected Q w h rs E)=
      (rs.map fun R => s(R.edge.1,R.edge.2)).foldl
        (originalStep (StoredSample.edgeSet Q) w hw t eligible host tape h)
        (StoredSample.edgeSet E)
headers.original_edges_eq_fold:
(Q : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ e,0≤w e) (t : ℚ) (eligible : Sym2 (Fin n) → Finset J)
    (host : J → Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) (tape : SampledGreedy.Tape (Fin n) J)
    (h : ℕ) (es : List (Sym2 (Fin n))) :
    ExecutableVoting.edges Q w hw t eligible host tape h es=
      es.reverse.foldl (originalStep Q w hw t eligible host tape h) Q
